title: Places --- and the Two Noun Families
label: ch:sa-places
canDo: I can name five places in Sanskrit, put a known adjective in front of any of them, and hear from a noun's ending whether it is neuter or masculine.

payoff.summary: Complete SA-C16-noun-families: sort the chapter's five places into the -am and -aH families and say a known adjective before each; recall what village, road and forest carry; then pick out ण and ग.
payoff.note: SA-C16-noun-families assesses eight of the chapter's nine atoms, including ण and ग (reached through SA-S218-letter-ga, sequence 761). The letter ज (SA-SCRIPT-RECOG-120) is introduced by SA-S120-letter-ja at sequence 781, after this payoff, and the chapter has no later lesson that could carry the payoff, so it is not assessed here.
